findings.message: `pagefront:purchaseVerification` on review `https://merchant.example/reviews/r-88102` at `$['data']['itemListElement'][2]['pagefront:purchaseVerification']` is `verified`, which is not one of `none`, `order_matched`, `post_purchase_invitation`, `platform_verified`, `undisclosed`.
findings.remediation: Declare `pagefront:purchaseVerification` on every review as `none`, `order_matched`, `post_purchase_invitation`, `platform_verified` or `undisclosed`; a publisher that does not know writes `undisclosed`, never nothing.
